name: v223_debt_reduction_interest_clean
hypothesis: Companies reducing debt while interest burden and beta slope fall should be financially healthier; this directly audits the user's debt-reduction idea under current strict gates.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * interest_expense / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(sales / assets, 252), 126), subindustry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Debt is historically crowded/high-corr, so this is a controlled baseline, not a preferred submit route.

name: v223_dividend_guidance_confidence
hypothesis: Stable and improving dividend-per-share expectations with low analyst dispersion may indicate shareholder-return confidence without relying on buyback or share-count fields.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.320 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_basic_af_v4_nd_div_mean / close, 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_basic_af_v4_nd_div_mean / close, 63), 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_basic_af_v4_nd_div_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_basic_af_v4_nd_div_low) / close, 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_basic_af_v4_nd_div_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Avoids direct buyback/share-count payout siblings; reject if it maps to existing payout/value capacity.

name: v223_sga_rd_operating_leverage_gap
hypothesis: Lower SG&A burden versus analyst expectation and restrained R&D guidance can signal operating leverage when analyst coverage is broadening.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_sga_value / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_sga_value - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_mean) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_maxguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_minguidance) / (2 * abs(sales)), 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_low) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.070 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Different from the existing SG&A/option-award ACTIVE by removing stock-comp and option-award sleeves.

name: v223_rd_growth_low_dispersion
hypothesis: R&D investment should be more valuable when sales growth is present and R&D guidance dispersion is low, separating productive innovation from unfocused spending.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(rd_expense / abs(sales), 126), subindustry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_minguidance) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 90), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Uses R&D as a productive investment signal, not as ordinary EPS/profitability or buyback stabilization.

name: v223_advertising_efficiency_largecap
hypothesis: Lower and stable advertising intensity paired with asset turnover may indicate efficient demand generation rather than expensive customer acquisition.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.55, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_xad) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / assets, 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta(fnd6_xad / abs(sales), 252)), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 90), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Large-cap repair of prior advertising LSUS weakness; reject if Fitness collapses or LSUS remains weak.
